knowledge_gaps: Evidence provenance is unresolved: the current code analyzer reports no perturbation probes, while historical results contain padding and cropping measurements. Identify the code version, checkpoint, precision settings and probe implementation behind each result before treating decreasing padding errors as an improvement.

The numerical gate lacks a reproducible decision rule. Predeclare reference computation, precision settings, absolute/relative error criteria and candidate-score checks. Repeated execution alone cannot detect a deterministic padding defect.

The baseline loss and reduction remain unspecified. B−A may change normalization, negative pools and effective regularization as well as supervision allocation. These details must be fixed before interpreting that contrast.

The experiment is not yet executable: the common epoch count, remaining GPU budget, diagnostic allowance and validation-query cap are placeholders. Twelve category-condition runs require a charged timing estimate and explicit stopping rules.

Training diagnostics need stronger sampling definitions. The first cached batches may contain repeated users, and row-weighted margins differ from position-weighted training losses. Record user counts, eligibility rules and aggregation weights; avoid conclusions from the zero-to-one examples in long-history strata.

Originality 4/10 is plausible, but the cited references do not establish prior art for sequence cropping. Potential 8/10 is optimistic without host validation results. Difficulty 5/10 depends on whether padding repair and matched sampling require substantial baseline changes.

Cropping changes the distribution of recurrent context lengths across supervised positions. Report these distributions and training-popularity strata to assess whether gains reflect shorter-context regularization or popularity shortcuts. A single seed and adaptively selected validation winner cannot establish robustness.
